definitions.explanation: The quality of food or drink that sustains health and promotes growth. Often used to describe foods that are particularly nutritious or health-giving.

examples.japanese: {滋養|じよう}のある{食事|しょくじ}をとる。
{病気|びょうき}の{後|あと}は{滋養|じよう}をつけなさい。
examples.english: Build up your strength after being sick.

examples.japanese: うなぎは{滋養|じよう}{強壮|きょうそう}の{食|た}べ{物|もの}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: Eel is known as a food that nourishes and invigorates the body.

notes:
{滋養|じよう} has a traditional, somewhat elevated tone compared to the more modern {栄養|えいよう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {滋養|じよう}をつける — to build up strength through food
- {滋養|じよう}のある — nourishing, nutritious
- {滋養|じよう}{強壮|きょうそう} — nourishment and invigoration
- {滋養|じよう}{豊富|ほうふ} — rich in nutrition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {栄養|えいよう} — nutrition (modern, scientific; the standard word)
- {滋養|じよう} — nourishment (traditional; suggests health-restoring qualities)

{滋養|じよう}{強壮|きょうそう} is a four-character compound commonly seen on traditional health foods and supplements.
